basic_details.job_title: Khagaria Civil Court Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Stenographer, Clerk and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Retired employees of the Civil Courts can apply for three support staff posts in the Evening Court, Khagaria: one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon / Orderly, engaged on a contractual basis. The Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Khagaria (Bihar) has asked that applications reach its office, either in person or through registered post, on or before 08 December 2026. The notice (Memo No. 6300 - 6302) is dated 18 November 2026, and the application window is open.

content_sections.heading: About Khagaria Civil Court
content_sections.text: The Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Khagaria heads the Khagaria Judgeship in Bihar, which also includes the Civil Court at Gogri. This notice fills support staff posts for the Evening Court of the Khagaria Judgeship, and the engagement follows the directions and guidelines of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send or deliver the application to: Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Khagaria. Mode: In person at the office, or through registered post. Deadline: The application must reach the office on or before 08 December 2026. The date counts receipt at the office, not the date of dispatch, so allow enough time for registered post. Application form: The notice does not attach or name an application format. The notice is being circulated to all judgeships of Bihar and placed on their notice boards, and it is also to be uploaded on the website of Civil Court, Khagaria.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Only retired court employees who retired within the last three years, as per the guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, are eligible. The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties of the post. The applicant must have satisfactory service records. The applicant should not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. It also prints no age limit. The only requirement is retirement from the Civil Courts within the last three years. The notice prints no remuneration amount. It states that the period of engagement, the remuneration and other conditions will be governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority. For the exact wording of each post's eligibility, see the official notification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Khagaria Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies in the Evening Court, Khagaria: 1 Stenographer, 1 Clerk and 1 Peon / Orderly.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Khagaria on or before 08 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Khagaria Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: Only retired employees of the Civil Courts who retired within the last three years, as per the guidelines of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, can apply. They must also have satisfactory service records and no major disciplinary punishment during service.

faq.question: Q4. What experience is needed for the Stenographer and Clerk posts?
faq.answer: The Stenographer needs the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing. The Clerk needs adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Deliver the application in person or send it by registered post to the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Khagaria. It must reach the office by 08 December 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual for the evening court and can be terminated at any time. It does not give any right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q7. What are the working hours?
faq.answer: Selected candidates must work for a minimum of 05 hours on each working day.

faq.question: Q8. Can the advertisement be cancelled?
faq.answer: Yes. The competent authority reserves the right to cancel or modify the advertisement or the selection process without assigning any reason.
